1.consolidated_definition: El enfermo campesino que no respondía en casa al tratamiento del curandero, solía trasladarse antaño en ocasiones al hospital municipal en el pueblo, llevado en una hamaca que se colgaba de un madero liviano pero resistente, por lo común un palo de bambú, con una sábana colgante de dicho palo a modo de cortina protectora del sol para el paciente, y cuya hamaca así preparada cargaban dos hombres, uno por cada extremo, turnándose los cargadores con otros cada cierta distancia en el recorrido a pie desde el campo al pueblo. “Se lo tuvieron que llevar al pueblo cargado en la hamaca”, solía decirse del enfermo rural así transportado.
1.en_consolidated_definition: The rural patient who did not respond to treatment at home would often be transported in the past on occasion to the municipal hospital in town, carried in a hammock suspended from a lightweight but sturdy pole, commonly a bamboo stick, with a hanging sheet attached to the pole serving as a protective curtain from the sun for the patient. The hammock, thus prepared, was loaded by two men, one at each end, who took turns with other carriers at certain intervals along the route on foot from the field to town. "They had to take him to town carried in the hammock," it would be said of this rural patient thus transported.
